allowed_inheritance: general evaluation infrastructure whose behavior is family-agnostic
generic isolation and provenance controls that do not encode H6 answers
forbidden_h6_transfer: H6 held-out prompts or prompt templates derived from them
H6 ground-truth labels, expected winners, decisive-evidence annotations
H6 observed ROBY answers or failure patterns
H6 scoring outcomes used to shape H7 cases
H6 benchmark-specific adapters, literals, routing, or special cases

h7_scope_freeze.hypothesis: H7 must be defined and measured on its own semantic capability

independence_principle: H7 is a new measurement cycle over the current productive ROBY baseline. It may inherit production code and architecture, but no privileged H6 experimental information may influence H7 corpus construction, ground truth, execution expectations, or scoring.
next_gate: HCPDQ-v2 H7 Independent Cycle — Hypothesis / Measurable Family Contract
required_separation_controls: independent H7 case identifiers and artifact namespace
construction artifacts must not import/read H6 held-out or scoring artifacts
ground truth must be frozen before ROBY exposure
ROBY execution artifacts must not contain ground truth
scoring must occur only after primary outputs are sealed
H6 historical evidence remains immutable and outside H7 scoring
